# Publisher

Publisher is a trichromatic, book-inspired layout that pairs a technical UI font with a traditional reading font. Its palette is black, white and orange, and borders are kept minimal to leave notes readable.

![Publisher screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aidanastridge/Publisher/HEAD/src/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Publisher"
    author: "aidanastridge"
    repo:   "aidanastridge/Publisher"
    slug:   "publisher"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/publisher"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/aidanastridge/Publisher"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aidanastridge/Publisher/HEAD/src/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a trichromatic, book-inspired layout that pairs a technical UI font with a traditional reading font. Keep notes clean and readable with minimal borders and a black, white, and orange palette."
}
```
